qualifier: drug conditioning, mating, parental and aggressive behavior
name: Drug-reward conditioning and social reproductive behaviors
rationale: All members are organism-level behaviors: drug (cocaine, ethanol, alkaloid) responses and conditioning/learning plus mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behavior, distinguishing it from confusables built on dopamine/opioid receptor signaling, neuropeptides, sleep or stress.

qualifier: proliferation, survival and differentiation in thymus
name: Regulation of thymocyte proliferation, survival and differentiation
rationale: All four members regulate immature T cell proliferation, apoptosis or differentiation within the thymus, unlike confusables covering T cell activation modules, bone marrow or kidney cell proliferation.

name: Nucleolar ribosome biogenesis control and MYC targets
rationale: Members concern growth-linked control of ribosome production (Pol I repression, SIRT1/nucleolar chromatin silencing of rRNA, methionine sensing, MYC target sets), whereas confusables cover Pol I initiation/termination machinery and rRNA processing steps and lack the MYC target sets.

core: Peroxisome biogenesis and peroxisomal lipid synthesis
qualifier: protein import, fatty acid elongation, ether lipids
name: Peroxisome biogenesis, fatty acid elongation and ether lipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover peroxisomal protein import/fission and anabolic lipid routes (VLCFA and PUFA elongation, plasmalogen/ether and wax synthesis), distinguishing them from confusables centred on peroxisomal fatty acid alpha/beta-oxidation.

qualifier: lipoprotein uptake and foam cell formation
name: Lipoprotein-driven macrophage cholesterol balance and foam cell formation
rationale: All members regulate cholesterol import, storage and efflux in response to lipoproteins (oxLDL, LXR targets) including foam cell differentiation, unlike confusables on HDL assembly, reverse cholesterol transport or phospholipid catabolism.

qualifier: taste, smell, pain and thermal sensing with K2P/TRP channels
name: Chemosensation, nociception and two-pore potassium/TRP channels
rationale: Members span taste, olfaction, pheromone, pain, itch and temperature sensing together with K2P and TRP channels, whereas confusables are limited to resting-potential K2P channels or tachykinin signaling without chemosensory perception.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and extravasation
rationale: Members concern leukocyte (neutrophil, T cell) adhesion to endothelium, integrin activation, PECAM1 interactions and diapedesis, distinguishing it from monocyte inflammatory activation, chemokine-driven homing and T cell immunological synapse confusables.

name: Zinc ion transport and homeostasis
rationale: Every member concerns zinc influx, efflux, organellar compartmentalization or zinc starvation (SLC39/SLC30), while confusables cover copper, manganese, cadmium and iron handling.

name: Erythropoietin and thrombopoietin receptor signaling
rationale: All members are EPO or TPO receptor signaling and its downstream PI3K, RAS, STAT5 and PLCG branches, unlike confusables on FLT3, PDGFR, ALK or growth hormone/prolactin receptors.

qualifier: PTEN control and inositol pyrophosphate synthesis
name: Phosphoinositide signaling: PTEN control and inositol pyrophosphate synthesis
rationale: Members combine PTEN/PI3K-AKT restraint (PTEN loss, ceRNA/lncRNA control, IGF1R inhibition) with inositol phosphate, pyrophosphate and nuclear PIP synthesis; confusables have only one of these halves plus AKT targets or pyrophosphate hydrolysis.

name: Regulation of mitochondrial respiration and oxidative-stress apoptosis
rationale: Members regulate oxidative phosphorylation, respiration, ATP and ROS production together with H2O2- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis; confusables have either the respiration side (with PGC-1alpha) or stress/ferroptosis side but not both.

name: Actin filament severing, capping and depolymerization
rationale: All three members concern actin filament disassembly by severing, capping and depolymerization, the opposite of confusables on actin polymerization, lamellipodia and bundling.

name: Canonical Wnt receptor activation and AXIN/DVL turnover
rationale: Members cover Wnt-FZD/LRP signaling at the membrane, destruction complex disassembly and ubiquitin-mediated FZD, DVL and AXIN turnover, whereas confusables emphasise Wnt secretion, non-canonical calcium signaling or nuclear beta-catenin/TCF output.

qualifier: mature mRNA through the nuclear pore
name: Mature mRNA export through the nuclear pore
rationale: Members describe export of mature (spliced, intronless, histone) mRNAs via the nuclear pore, distinguishing them from confusables on pore assembly, ribosomal subunit or viral RNA export, and mRNA 3'-end processing and decay.

name: Synaptic transmission modulation, vesicle clustering and dendrite extension
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic vesicle clustering, cytoskeleton, transmitter secretion and uptake, plus dendrite extension and receptor retention, whereas confusables focus on neurotransmitter release cycles or clathrin-mediated vesicle recycling.

name: PPARalpha-driven fatty acid response and mitochondrial biogenesis
rationale: All three members link fatty acid sensing to PPARalpha gene activation and mitochondrial biogenesis, unlike confusables on fatty acid oxidation control, PPARG adipogenesis or LXR lipogenesis.

qualifier: vitamin K gamma-carboxylation and vitamin D activation
name: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and vitamin D metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors plus vitamin D activation and its CYP defects; confusables lack the vitamin K arm and instead cover mineralization, phosphate transport or retinoic acid.

name: Steroidogenesis of corticosteroids and sex hormones
rationale: Members span pregnenolone, gluco/mineralocorticoid, androgen, estrogen and progesterone synthesis and steroidogenic CYP defects, distinguishing them from confusables limited to aldosterone/cortisol regulation or vitamin D/retinoid metabolism.

name: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and cell cycle progression
rationale: Members are E2F target and network sets with G1/S and G2/M progression, whereas confusables centre on G2/M checkpoint control or replication origin licensing and initiation.

qualifier: collagen crosslinking and matrix glycan turnover
name: Ascorbate metabolism with collagen crosslinking and matrix glycan turnover
rationale: Members join vitamin C metabolism and transport with collagen crosslinking, basement membrane assembly, proteoglycan and hyaluronan turnover, which confusables (ROS detoxification, BH4, vitamin K, iron) lack.

qualifier: neutral amino acids, polyamines and inositol
name: Neutral amino acid, polyamine and inositol transmembrane transport
rationale: Members transport neutral/aromatic amino acids, polyamines and inositol, distinguishing them from confusables on cationic amino acid and oligopeptide transport.

name: Stress- and oncogene-induced senescence with SASP
rationale: Members promote stress-, oxidative- and oncogene-induced senescence, the SASP and Polycomb-linked proliferative arrest, whereas confusables concern heterochromatin foci, UV responses or senescence evasion in cancer.

name: Amyloid precursor processing and glial activation in neurodegeneration
rationale: Members regulate APP/amyloid-beta production, tangle assembly and amide metabolism alongside microglial and astrocyte activation and glial survival, whereas confusables focus on amyloid fibril formation and amyloid-beta clearance.

name: Chaperonin-mediated cytoskeletal protein folding and tubulin modification
rationale: Members cover TRiC/CCT and prefoldin folding of tubulin and actin plus tubulin glutamylation, acetylation and microtubule severing, unlike confusables on general chaperone refolding, ER folding or histone acetylation.

name: Vasopressin-regulated renal water, sodium and osmotic homeostasis
rationale: Members concern vasopressin/aquaporin water reabsorption, renal sodium and chloride transport and cellular osmotic responses, distinguishing them from confusables on renin-angiotensin control or cation-chloride cotransporter disorders.
